column2:
dance(n./v.)舞蹈、跳舞
dancer(n.)舞者
dancing(n.)跳舞、舞蹈
dance class 舞蹈課
dance party 舞會
Let's dance to this song together.
(我們一起隨著這首歌跳舞吧。)
She takes a dance class every Saturday.
(她每週六上一堂舞蹈課。)

dangerous(adj.)危險的
danger(n.)危險
dangerously(adv.)危險地
dangerous animal 危險的動物
extremely dangerous 極度危險
It is dangerous to swim here.
(在這裡游泳很危險。)
Driving too fast is very dangerous.
(開車開太快非常危險。)

dark(adj./n.)黑暗的、深色的、黑暗
darkness(n.)黑暗
darken(v.)使變暗
dark blue 深藍色
after dark 天黑以後
It gets dark early in winter.
(冬天天黑得很早。)
Don't walk home alone after dark.
(天黑以後不要獨自走路回家。)

date(n./v.)日期、約會、和……約會
(無詞性變化)
due date 到期日
go on a date 去約會
What is the date today?
(今天是幾月幾號？)
They went on a date last Friday.
(他們上週五去約會了。)

daughter(n.)女兒
(無詞性變化)
only daughter 獨生女
eldest daughter 長女
Their daughter is five years old.
(他們的女兒五歲了。)
She is the only daughter in her family.
(她是家裡的獨生女。)

day(n.)天、日、白天
daily(adj./adv.)每日的、每天
all day 一整天
day off 休假日
I study English every day.
(我每天都讀英文。)
We stayed at home all day.
(我們一整天都待在家。)

dead(adj.)死的、無生命的、沒電的
die(v.)死亡
death(n.)死亡
dead body 屍體
dead battery 沒電的電池
My phone is dead, so I can't call you.
(我的手機沒電了，所以不能打給你。)
The fish in the tank are dead.
(魚缸裡的魚死了。)

deal(n./v.)交易、處理、對付
dealer(n.)商人、經銷商
a great deal 大量、很多
deal with 處理
It's a deal!
(就這麼說定了！)
I need to deal with this problem now.
(我現在需要處理這個問題。)

dear(adj./n./adv.)親愛的、寶貴的、親愛的人
dearly(adv.)深深地、非常
dear friend 親愛的朋友
Oh dear 哎呀、天啊
Dear Tom, thank you for your letter.
(親愛的湯姆，謝謝你的來信。)
Oh dear, I forgot my keys again!
(哎呀，我又忘了帶鑰匙！)

death(n.)死亡、去世
die(v.)死亡
dead(adj.)死的
sudden death 猝死、驟死
life and death 生死
His death made everyone very sad.
(他的去世讓大家都很難過。)
This is a matter of life and death.
(這是攸關生死的事。)

decide(v.)決定、下決心
decision(n.)決定
decide on 決定、選定
decide to do 決定做某事
I decided to learn the guitar.
(我決定學吉他。)
We can't decide where to eat.
(我們決定不了要去哪裡吃飯。)

deep(adj./adv.)深的、深深地
depth(n.)深度
deeply(adv.)深深地
deep breath 深呼吸
deep sleep 熟睡
Take a deep breath and relax.
(深呼吸，放輕鬆。)
The lake is very deep here.
(這裡的湖水非常深。)

define(v.)下定義、界定
definition(n.)定義
defined(adj.)明確的
define a word 為字下定義
clearly define 清楚界定
Can you define this word for me?
(你可以幫我解釋這個字的定義嗎？)
It is hard to define happiness.
(幸福很難下定義。)

desk(n.)書桌、辦公桌
(無詞性變化)
front desk 櫃檯
desk lamp 檯燈
My books are on the desk.
(我的書在書桌上。)
Please ask at the front desk.
(請到櫃檯詢問。)

dictionary(n.)字典、辭典
(無詞性變化)
English dictionary 英文字典
look up in a dictionary 查字典
I look up new words in my dictionary.
(我在字典裡查新單字。)
May I borrow your English dictionary?
(我可以借你的英文字典嗎？)

die(v.)死亡、枯死
death(n.)死亡
dead(adj.)死的
die of 死於（疾病等）
be dying to 渴望
The flowers died because I forgot to water them.
(因為我忘了澆水，花都枯死了。)
I'm dying to see the new movie.
(我超想看那部新電影。)

different(adj.)不同的、各種的
difference(n.)差異、不同
differ(v.)不同
different from 與……不同
completely different 完全不同
My sister is very different from me.
(我妹妹和我很不一樣。)
We visited many different places.
(我們去了很多不同的地方。)

difficult(adj.)困難的、難相處的
difficulty(n.)困難
difficult question 困難的問題
difficult time 艱難時期
This math problem is very difficult.
(這道數學題很難。)
It is difficult to wake up early.
(早起很困難。)

dig(v./n.)挖、掘、挖掘
(無詞性變化)
dig a hole 挖洞
dig up 挖出
The dog is digging a hole in the yard.
(那隻狗正在院子裡挖洞。)
They dug up some old coins.
(他們挖出了一些古老的硬幣。)

dinner(n.)晚餐、正餐
(無詞性變化)
have dinner 吃晚餐
dinner party 晚宴
We have dinner at seven.
(我們七點吃晚餐。)
Mom is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
(媽媽正在廚房煮晚餐。)

dirty(adj./v.)髒的、弄髒
dirt(n.)泥土、汙垢
dirty clothes 髒衣服
dirty work 苦差事
Your shoes are dirty.
(你的鞋子很髒。)
Put your dirty clothes in the basket.
(把你的髒衣服放進籃子裡。)

dish(n./v.)盤子、菜餚、盛菜
(無詞性變化)
wash the dishes 洗碗
main dish 主菜
I wash the dishes after dinner.
(我晚餐後洗碗。)
This is my favorite dish.
(這是我最喜歡的一道菜。)

do(aux./v.)做、從事、（助動詞）
doer(n.)實行者
do homework 做功課
do one's best 盡力
Do you like apples?
(你喜歡蘋果嗎？)
I always do my homework after school.
(我總是放學後寫功課。)

doctor(n.)醫生、博士
doc(n.)醫生(口語)
see a doctor 看醫生
family doctor 家庭醫師
You should see a doctor.
(你應該去看醫生。)
My uncle is a doctor at that hospital.
(我叔叔是那家醫院的醫生。)

dog(n.)狗
doggy(n.)小狗(兒語)
walk the dog 遛狗
pet dog 寵物狗
I walk my dog every morning.
(我每天早上遛狗。)
The dog is sleeping under the table.
(那隻狗在桌子底下睡覺。)

doll(n.)洋娃娃、玩偶
(無詞性變化)
rag doll 布娃娃
play with dolls 玩洋娃娃
My little sister loves her doll.
(我妹妹很愛她的洋娃娃。)
The girls are playing with dolls.
(女孩們正在玩洋娃娃。)

dollar(n.)元(美元等貨幣單位)
(無詞性變化)
US dollar 美元
dollar bill 一元紙鈔
This pen costs two dollars.
(這支筆要兩美元。)
He saved fifty dollars last month.
(他上個月存了五十元。)

door(n.)門
doorway(n.)門口
front door 前門
knock on the door 敲門
Please close the door.
(請把門關上。)
Someone is knocking on the door.
(有人在敲門。)

down(adv./prep./adj./n./v.)向下、沿著、沮喪的
downward(adj./adv.)向下的、向下
sit down 坐下
feel down 心情低落
Please sit down here.
(請坐在這裡。)
She feels a little down today.
(她今天心情有點低落。)

dozen(n.)一打、十二個
(無詞性變化)
a dozen eggs 一打蛋
dozens of 數十個、很多
I bought a dozen eggs.
(我買了一打蛋。)
Dozens of people came to the party.
(好幾十個人來參加派對。)

draw(v./n.)畫、拉、抽籤、平手
drawing(n.)圖畫
drawer(n.)抽屜
draw a picture 畫一幅畫
draw attention 吸引注意
I like to draw animals.
(我喜歡畫動物。)
The game ended in a draw.
(比賽以平手收場。)

dream(n./v.)夢、夢想、做夢
dreamer(n.)夢想家
dream come true 夢想成真
bad dream 惡夢
I had a strange dream last night.
(我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。)
Her dream is to be a teacher.
(她的夢想是當老師。)

dress(n./v.)洋裝、服裝、穿衣
dressing(n.)醬料、包紮
dressed(adj.)穿好衣服的
get dressed 穿好衣服
dress up 盛裝打扮
She is wearing a red dress.
(她穿著一件紅色洋裝。)
Hurry up and get dressed!
(快點把衣服穿好！)

drink(v./n.)喝、飲料
drinker(n.)飲酒者
soft drink 汽水、無酒精飲料
drink water 喝水
Drink more water every day.
(每天要多喝水。)
Would you like a cold drink?
(你想來杯冷飲嗎？)

drive(v./n.)開車、駕駛、車程
driver(n.)駕駛人
driving(n.)駕駛
drive a car 開車
an hour's drive 一小時車程
My father drives me to school.
(我爸爸開車送我上學。)
The beach is a short drive from here.
(海灘離這裡只有一小段車程。)

driver(n.)駕駛人、司機
drive(v.)開車
taxi driver 計程車司機
bus driver 公車司機
The bus driver is very friendly.
(那位公車司機很友善。)
My uncle is a taxi driver.
(我叔叔是計程車司機。)

drop(v./n.)掉落、放下、滴
(無詞性變化)
drop by 順道拜訪
a drop of water 一滴水
Don't drop the glass!
(別把杯子摔了！)
Please drop by my house tomorrow.
(明天請順道來我家坐坐。)

drum(n./v.)鼓、打鼓
drummer(n.)鼓手
play the drums 打鼓
drum set 爵士鼓組
He plays the drums in a band.
(他在樂團裡打鼓。)
The children drummed on the table.
(孩子們在桌上敲打。)

dry(adj./v.)乾的、乾燥的、弄乾
dryer(n.)烘乾機、吹風機
dry season 乾季
dry clothes 晾乾衣服
The towel is dry now.
(毛巾現在乾了。)
Dry your hands before you eat.
(吃飯前把手擦乾。)

duck(n./v.)鴨子、閃避
duckling(n.)小鴨
roast duck 烤鴨
duck down 低頭閃避
There are ducks in the pond.
(池塘裡有鴨子。)
He ducked to avoid the ball.
(他低頭閃避那顆球。)

during(prep.)在……期間
(無詞性變化)
during the day 在白天
during the summer 在夏天期間
Please don't talk during the test.
(考試期間請不要講話。)
We went to Japan during the summer vacation.
(我們暑假期間去了日本。)

each(pron./adj./adv.)每個、各自
(無詞性變化)
each other 彼此、互相
each time 每次
Each student has a book.
(每個學生都有一本書。)
The two friends help each other.
(那兩個朋友互相幫忙。)

ear(n.)耳朵、聽力
earring(n.)耳環
ear infection 耳朵發炎
all ears 洗耳恭聽
She whispered in my ear.
(她在我耳邊低語。)
Tell me your story. I'm all ears.
(告訴我你的故事，我洗耳恭聽。)

early(adj./adv.)早的、提早地
(無詞性變化)
early morning 清晨
get up early 早起
I get up early every day.
(我每天都很早起床。)
We arrived ten minutes early.
(我們提早十分鐘到達。)

earth(n.)地球、土地、泥土
earthquake(n.)地震
on earth 究竟、在世界上
the Earth's surface 地球表面
The Earth goes around the sun.
(地球繞著太陽轉。)
What on earth are you doing?
(你到底在做什麼？)

east(n./adj./adv.)東方、東方的、向東
eastern(adj.)東方的、東部的
the Far East 遠東
east coast 東海岸
The sun rises in the east.
(太陽從東方升起。)
Hualien is on the east coast of Taiwan.
(花蓮位於台灣東海岸。)

easy(adj.)容易的、輕鬆的
easily(adv.)容易地
ease(n./v.)容易、減輕
take it easy 放輕鬆
easy question 簡單的問題
This test is very easy.
(這次考試很簡單。)
Take it easy. Everything will be fine.
(放輕鬆，一切都會沒事的。)

eat(v.)吃、吃飯
(無詞性變化)
eat out 外出吃飯
eat breakfast 吃早餐
We often eat out on Sundays.
(我們週日常常外出吃飯。)
You should eat more vegetables.
(你應該多吃蔬菜。)

egg(n.)蛋、卵
(無詞性變化)
boiled egg 水煮蛋
fried egg 煎蛋
I had two eggs for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了兩顆蛋。)
The bird laid three eggs in its nest.
(那隻鳥在巢裡下了三顆蛋。)

either(adv./pron./adj./conj.)也（不）、兩者任一
(無詞性變化)
either A or B 不是A就是B
either side 兩邊任一邊
I don't like coffee either.
(我也不喜歡咖啡。)
You can choose either of the two cakes.
(這兩個蛋糕你可以任選一個。)

elephant(n.)大象
(無詞性變化)
baby elephant 小象
African elephant 非洲象
Elephants have long noses.
(大象有長長的鼻子。)
We saw a baby elephant at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到一隻小象。)

else(adv.)其他的、另外的
elsewhere(adv.)在別處
or else 否則
someone else 別人
What else do you need?
(你還需要什麼別的嗎？)
Hurry up, or else you'll be late.
(快一點，否則你會遲到。)

email(n./v.)電子郵件、寄電子郵件
(無詞性變化)
send an email 寄電子郵件
email address 電子郵件地址
Please send me an email tonight.
(今晚請寄電子郵件給我。)
I'll email you the photos.
(我會把照片用電子郵件寄給你。)

end(n./v.)結束、末端、終止
ending(n.)結局
endless(adj.)無止境的
in the end 最後
at the end of 在……的末尾
The movie had a happy ending, and in the end everyone smiled.
(這部電影有個快樂結局，最後大家都笑了。)
The class ends at noon.
(這堂課在中午結束。)

engineer(n.)工程師
engineering(n.)工程學
software engineer 軟體工程師
civil engineer 土木工程師
My father is an engineer.
(我爸爸是一名工程師。)
She wants to be a software engineer.
(她想成為一名軟體工程師。)

enjoy(v.)享受、喜歡、enjoyment(n.)樂趣、享受
enjoyable(adj.)令人愉快的
enjoy oneself 玩得開心
enjoy the view 欣賞風景
Did you enjoy yourself at the party?
(你在派對上玩得開心嗎？)
I enjoy reading in my free time.
(我空閒時喜歡看書。)

enough(adv./adj./n.)足夠地、足夠的、足夠
(無詞性變化)
enough money 足夠的錢
old enough 年紀夠大
We don't have enough time.
(我們沒有足夠的時間。)
He is old enough to drive.
(他已經到了可以開車的年紀。)

enter(v.)進入、參加、輸入
entrance(n.)入口
entry(n.)進入、參賽作品
enter a room 進入房間
enter a contest 參加比賽
Please knock before you enter.
(進來之前請先敲門。)
She entered a singing contest.
(她參加了一場歌唱比賽。)

envelope(n.)信封
(無詞性變化)
red envelope 紅包
seal an envelope 封信封
Put the letter in the envelope.
(把信放進信封裡。)
Kids get red envelopes during Chinese New Year.
(孩子們在農曆新年會拿到紅包。)

eraser(n.)橡皮擦、板擦
erase(v.)擦掉、消除
pencil eraser 鉛筆橡皮擦
board eraser 板擦
Can I borrow your eraser?
(我可以借你的橡皮擦嗎？)
I lost my eraser at school.
(我在學校弄丟了橡皮擦。)

error(n.)錯誤、失誤
(無詞性變化)
make an error 犯錯
spelling error 拼字錯誤
There is a spelling error here.
(這裡有一個拼字錯誤。)
Everyone makes errors sometimes.
(每個人有時都會犯錯。)

even(adv./adj./v.)甚至、偶數的、平坦的、使平均
evenly(adv.)均勻地
even number 偶數
even if 即使
Even a child can do it.
(連小孩子都會做。)
Two, four, and six are even numbers.
(二、四、六是偶數。)

evening(n.)傍晚、晚上
(無詞性變化)
this evening 今晚
in the evening 在傍晚
I do my homework in the evening.
(我在晚上做功課。)
Are you free this evening?
(你今晚有空嗎？)

ever(adv.)曾經、從來、究竟
forever(adv.)永遠
ever since 自從……以後
than ever 比以往更
Have you ever been to Japan?
(你曾經去過日本嗎？)
She is happier than ever.
(她比以往更快樂。)

every(adj.)每一、每個
(無詞性變化)
every day 每天
every other day 每隔一天
I brush my teeth every morning.
(我每天早上刷牙。)
Every student must wear a uniform.
(每位學生都必須穿制服。)

everyone(pron.)每個人、大家
everybody(pron.)每個人、大家
everyone else 其他所有人
hello everyone 大家好
Hello, everyone! Welcome to class.
(大家好！歡迎來上課。)
Everybody likes her new song.
(大家都喜歡她的新歌。)

everything(pron.)每件事、一切
(無詞性變化)
everything else 其他一切
everything is fine 一切都好
Thank you for everything.
(謝謝你所做的一切。)
Don't worry. Everything is fine.
(別擔心，一切都很好。)

example(n.)例子、榜樣
(無詞性變化)
for example 例如
set an example 樹立榜樣
Can you give me an example?
(你可以給我舉個例子嗎？)
I like fruit, for example, apples and bananas.
(我喜歡水果，例如蘋果和香蕉。)

excellent(adj.)極好的、優秀的
excellence(n.)卓越
excel(v.)擅長、勝過
excellent student 優秀的學生
excellent idea 絕佳的點子
That's an excellent idea!
(那真是個絕佳的點子！)
She is an excellent student.
(她是一位優秀的學生。)

except(prep./conj.)除了……之外
exception(n.)例外
except for 除了……之外
except that 只是、除了
Everyone came except Tom.
(除了湯姆之外，大家都來了。)
The store is open every day except Monday.
(這家店除了週一之外每天都營業。)

excited(adj.)興奮的、激動的
excite(v.)使興奮
excitement(n.)興奮
get excited 變得興奮
excited about 對……感到興奮
The kids are excited about the trip.
(孩子們對這趟旅行感到很興奮。)
Don't get too excited.
(別太激動。)

exciting(adj.)令人興奮的、刺激的
excite(v.)使興奮
excitement(n.)興奮
exciting game 刺激的比賽
exciting news 令人興奮的消息
The basketball game was very exciting.
(那場籃球比賽非常刺激。)
I have some exciting news for you.
(我有個令人興奮的消息要告訴你。)

exercise(n./v.)運動、練習、做運動
(無詞性變化)
do exercise 做運動
grammar exercise 文法練習
I exercise in the park every morning.
(我每天早上在公園運動。)
Please finish the exercises on page ten.
